steps.title: Declarative ArgoCD Application CRD Manifest
steps.description: Construct a fully qualified ArgoCD `Application` Custom Resource manifest specifying source Git repo, target revision, and destination cluster namespace.

verification.command: test -f /home/student/gitops/argocd-app.yaml && grep -q 'argoproj.io/v1alpha1' /home/student/gitops/argocd-app.yaml && grep -q 'kind: Application' /home/student/gitops/argocd-app.yaml && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Automated Sync & Self-Healing SyncPolicy
steps.description: Configure automated synchronization, pruning of deleted resources, and self-healing to automatically revert manual cluster drift.
tasks: Enable `prune: true` so removed Git files are deleted in Kubernetes
Enable `selfHeal: true` to prevent uncommitted `kubectl edit` manual drift

verification.command: grep -q 'selfHeal: true' /home/student/gitops/argocd-app.yaml && grep -q 'prune: true' /home/student/gitops/argocd-app.yaml && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: App-of-Apps Multi-Cluster Master Pattern
steps.description: Design an enterprise App-of-Apps root catalog repository that boots multiple microservices with a single Git commit.
tasks: Verify all YAML files have valid syntax

verification.command: test -f /home/student/gitops/apps/root-app.yaml && test -f /home/student/gitops/apps/frontend-app.yaml && test -f /home/student/gitops/apps/backend-app.yaml && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Kustomize Multi-Environment Overlays
steps.description: Set up a clean Kustomize directory hierarchy with a shared base and environment-specific overlays for `staging` and `production`.

verification.command: test -f /home/student/kustomize/base/kustomization.yaml && test -f /home/student/kustomize/overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml && grep -q 'replicas' /home/student/kustomize/overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Argo Rollouts Canary Progressive Delivery
steps.description: Write a canary release manifest using `argoproj.io/v1alpha1 Rollout` with automated weight step-ups (20% -> 50% -> 100%).

verification.command: test -f /home/student/gitops/canary-rollout.yaml && grep -q 'kind: Rollout' /home/student/gitops/canary-rollout.yaml && grep -q 'setWeight: 20' /home/student/gitops/canary-rollout.yaml && echo PASS || echo FAIL
